start_frame: Low from the floor at the curtain back toward the glass table, square-on to the bottle's neck: the paper label DRINK ME beautifully printed in large letters and sharp across its whole width, the glass tabletop above it, her hands just entering frame.
end_frame: The same square-on frame as both hands close round the bottle and lift it off the glass; the label stays flat to the lens for the whole read.
constraint_honoured: 'DRINK ME gets exactly one clean legible read here' — square-on, still, and the only time the bottle is hero-lit.
movement_note: A move across a hand-lettered label is the reliable way to make generated lettering garble; 3.0 s square-on and locked is the safest form of this shot.
